validator.source_text:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE scxml [
  <!ENTITY secret SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
]>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="copy">&secret;</data>
  </datamodel>
  <final id="a"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: external entities are never read by this parser (XML 1.0 §4.4.3 lets a non-validating processor not include them)
notes: the parser processes the internal DTD subset as XML 1.0 §5.1 requires of a non-validating processor; it never reads an external entity (XML 1.0 §4.4.3 lets a non-validating processor not include one, and reading it could disclose files or reach the network), and after a reference to a parameter entity that is not read it does not process later entity and attribute-list declarations (§5.1)
diagnostics.help: write the text in place, or declare an internal entity (`<!ENTITY name "text">`) in the internal subset
spec_references: XML 1.0 (Fifth Edition) §4.4 XML Processor Treatment of Entities and References
